stories.title: Buckley gets one of ten new Network Rail weather stations on railway radio masts
stories.summary: Buckley is one of ten places across Wales and the Borders where Network Rail has fitted weather stations to railway radio masts to help it respond to storms. stories.title: Hawarden entrepreneur says early dyslexia support at school changed her life
stories.summary: A Hawarden woman who dreaded reading aloud in class because of dyslexia now co-runs an employee benefits firm she describes as a multi-million pound business. stories.title: Flintshire loses 290 of its smallest businesses in three years
stories.summary: The number of very small businesses in Flintshire has fallen by 290 in three years, even as the county bucked a Wales-wide drop in established firms. stories.title: Seventeen students awarded black belts at Deeside Taekwondo Academy
stories.summary: Seventeen students at Deeside Taekwondo Academy have been awarded black belts at a recent presentation. Ten of them achieved their first dan, the first black belt grade.
